info.title: Tellurion — 3D Tiles for 3D places
info.description: OGC API — Common (Core, landing page, conformance, OpenAPI) plus 3D Tiles 1.1 glTF delivery for 3D places (follows the OGC API — 3D GeoVolumes URL shape; that standard is still a candidate draft with no approved conformance class to claim) for one catalog. Mounted at /{tenant}/3dtiles/catalogs/{catalog}.

200.description: Links to the API description, conformance declaration, and data.
The OpenAPI 3.0 document describing this API.

get.summary: 3D Tiles 1.1 tileset document for a collection's extruded 3D places

200.description: A 3D Tiles 1.1 `tileset.json` (implicit quadtree tiling, `content.uri` templated at the .glb tile endpoint below). Follows the `/collections/{cid}/3dtiles` URL shape from OGC API — 3D GeoVolumes without claiming conformance to it — that standard is still a candidate draft with no approved conformance class to cite. The bounding region is always whole-world in this milestone; `implicitTiling.subtrees.uri` is served by the subtree route below.

404.description: Unknown collection, or the collection has no `places3d` configuration.

get.summary: Fetch a single glTF binary (.glb) 3D tile, extruded from MVT feature footprints at request time

parameters.name: tileCol
parameters.description: Tile column with a mandatory `.glb` suffix — this route serves glTF binary content only, no negotiation.

200.description: glTF binary (.glb) tile content: footprint polygons from the MVT-first lane extruded into prism meshes per the collection's `places3d` config.

204.description: A valid tile at this coordinate with no features to extrude.

404.description: Unknown collection, no `places3d` configuration, or the zoom is outside the collection's configured range.

get.summary: Fetch the implicit-tiling subtree availability document
get.description: The availability document a spec-compliant 3D Tiles client resolves before requesting any .glb content, matching the tileset's own `implicitTiling.subtrees.uri` template. With `subtreeLevels` equal to `availableLevels`, the collection's whole declared zoom range fits inside exactly one subtree, so only the implicit root coordinate `0/0/0.subtree` names a real one — every other coordinate is a 404.

parameters.name: tileMatrix
parameters.description: Subtree root level; only `0` names a real subtree.

parameters.name: tileRow
parameters.description: Subtree root row; only `0` names a real subtree.

parameters.name: tileCol
parameters.description: Subtree root column with a mandatory `.subtree` suffix; only `0.subtree` names a real subtree.

200.description: The binary 3D Tiles 1.1 subtree availability document.

404.description: Unknown collection, no `places3d` configuration, or a coordinate other than the implicit root.

notFound.description: Unknown collection or feature, or the driver doesn't support this capability.
